crs_note: Geometry WGS84 (EPSG:4326) lon/lat, 7 decimals. Heights *_z_m are LN02 metres above sea level (swissBUILDINGS3D is LV95/LN02). height_m = roof_max_z_m - terrain_point_z_m (GELAENDEPUNKT), else - terrain_z_m (swissALTI3D 2 m at lv95_e/lv95_n); see height_base. ground_surface_z_m is the source GroundSurface, which swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 places ~3 m below the terrain (walls are extended underground), so it is not a ground level. Footprints are the union of GroundSurface polygons (else roof polygons), simplified with a 5 cm tolerance.
